sources.title_en: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3
sources.title_original: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3
sources.summary:
A Blog post by Liquid AI on Hugging Face
A Blog post by Liquid AI on Hugging Face
LFM3 is our new generation of Liquid Foundation Models (LFMs), built to be the starting point for specialized intelligence. It brings text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models onto one shared backbone, all in the 2B parameter range. This means you can pick the model for your modality, fine-tune it on your own data on a single GPU, and deploy it where your application runs.
LFM3 brings four main changes compare
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Liquid AI 发布2B参数级 LFM3，文本、视觉、音频共用 backbone，可单GPU微调；LFM3-1.7B 在8K上下文比 LFM2-1.2B 快约25%。

en.reason: Liquid AI's LFM3 puts text, vision and audio models on one shared backbone in the 2B parameter range, enabling single-GPU fine-tuning, with LFM3-1.7B about 25% faster than LFM2-1.2B at 8K context.

sources.summary: Anthropic 计划通过长期受益信托和 Founder LLC 等独特治理结构上市，在公开市场融资的同时防止股东迫使公司削弱安全投入。信托的五名投票受托人可通过 Class T 股票任命七名董事中的四席，七位创始人则以 Founder LLC 掌握 50.1% 投票权。法学专家认为法律层面可隔绝逐利压力，但市场竞争、融资需求和创始人离开都可能侵蚀这些保障。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic计划IPO，想靠public benefit corporation身份和限制股东影响董事会的治理设计抵御华尔街压力，Dario Amodei与Daniela Amodei均在董事会，但专家质疑其上市后难守安全优先。

en.summary: Anthropic plans to go public through unique governance structures such as a long-term benefit trust and Founder LLC, raising capital in public markets while preventing shareholders from forcing the company to weaken safety spending. The trust’s five voting trustees can appoint four of seven board seats through Class T stock, while the seven founders control 50.1% of voting power via Founder LLC. Legal experts say the structure can legally insulate the company from profit-driven pressure, but market competition, financing needs and founder departures could all erode these safeguards.
en.reason: Anthropic plans an IPO with a public benefit corporation, a five-trustee long-term benefit trust appointing four of seven directors via Class T shares, and a Founder LLC holding 50.1% voting power, as experts question whether safety-first governance survives market pressure.

en.title: OpenAI says its AI model has achieved three scientific breakthroughs, spanning the local smoothing conjecture, the exponential time hypothesis, and Yang–Mills theory
en.summary: On October 27, OpenAI announced that its AI model had achieved three research breakthroughs in mathematics, computer science and physics. en.reason: OpenAI said on October 27 its AI model proved the all-dimension local smoothing conjecture, refuted the exponential time hypothesis, and supplied a four-dimensional QCD and pure Yang–Mills existence proof, with the first two Lean-verified and physics awaiting review.
